selection: One fixed positive-Y neighbor, +32 vox from central crop, chosen before outcomes; v2 code frozen; no alternative window search
input_method: CT native uint8 (or uint16 //257), Otsu from active window; prediction zero outside active ROI; real raw CT retained in whole parent

evaluation_plan.surface: all output charts plus source-component-specific summary
evaluation_plan.boundary: all source boundary vertices before separation; distances to final triangle surfaces
evaluation_plan.tip: largest-area source face component; positive extreme along its widest XYZ bounding-box axis, lexicographic tie break; freeze before corrected run
evaluation_plan.annotations: post-hoc reference coverage and mixed-label face cues only

limitations: Different cube but same scroll; not a new scroll test
Same CT cube as development; this new window was not used to tune v2
Otsu is a classical intensity baseline, not a trained surface predictor
Artificial crop boundaries exist; geometric tip is not a certified torn anatomical tip
No halo/seam or whole F0 validation
